Chain forward star stores all edges in arrays: to[e], nxt[e], and head[u] = the newest edge leaving u. Adding an edge pushes it at the front of u's list: nxt[cnt] = head[u], head[u] = cnt. Walking u's list: for (e = head[u]; e; e = nxt[e]).

It is a linked list per vertex built in one array, so it never reallocates. Edge numbers are stable, so the reverse edge of e can be e ^ 1 (start cnt at 1 so the first pair is 2, 3), exactly what flows need (第1章).
Neighbours come out in reverse input order.
Directed edges 1→2, 1→3, 2→3, 3→4, 1→4, 4→2. Vertex 1 lists 4, 3, 2: newest first. Edge 0 is the "end" marker, which is why counting starts at 1.
For undirected graphs add both directions and size M = 2m. With weights, add a third array w[e].
Blocks of √n; split when too big.

A block linked list (块状链表) stores a sequence as a list of blocks of about √n elements each. To find position k, skip whole blocks by their sizes (O(√n)), then index inside one block. Insert / delete only shift elements inside one block (O(√n)). When a block grows past 2√n, split it in two.

It sits between an array (fast index, slow insert) and a linked list (fast insert, slow index): both operations O(√n). A balanced tree with implicit keys (第4章) does the same in O(log n), but the block list is simpler and has small constants (文本编辑器 P4008).

Random inserts and k-th queries checked against a plain Python list. Here std::list of vectors keeps the code short; the iterator loops are the one place where an iterator (not an index) is the natural tool. B is tiny only to make splits happen on a small test.
Range add, range sum in 1D and 2D.

Range add, range sum with Fenwick trees. 1D: keep the difference array d; a1 + … + ax = (x + 1)·Σdi − Σ i·di, so two Fenwick trees (d and i·d) give both operations in O(log n). 2D: the same expansion over (i, j) needs four trees: d, i·d, j·d, i·j·d.

Rectangle add = 4 corner updates of the 2D difference (第24章), rectangle sum = inclusion-exclusion of 4 prefix sums. Each is O(log n · log m) on the 2D Fenwick tree (上帝造题的七分钟 P4514). A 2D segment tree / tree of trees is the heavier alternative when the operation is not additive.
